correctness.rationale: The all-parameter proof derives a bijection between perfect matchings and monomer/dimer tilings, gives an iff support criterion via external-neighbor matchings and forbidden 1-rooted odd alternating runs, then enumerates maximal alternating runs by a two-state matrix and inserts all physical horizontal-edge choices with an independent twofold factor. Formal series algebra yields 1/(1-t-4zt^2+zt^3), and exact coefficient extraction proves every listed consequence. Graph-native perfect-matching enumeration independently agrees with structural shattering on 246930 supports; coefficient identities were checked as exact integers for all lengths through 100. Finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The most directly relevant complete primary result for the identical open ladder edge-membership concept family states the scalar VC dimension and adaptive dimension bounds but not any all-face support enumeration or alternating-run criterion. The fully read binary-string and resonance-graph sources study distinct incidence systems and a different cube polynomial, respectively. Direct published-finding corpus searches for the exact rational generating function, formula aliases and all-edge ladder supports did not identify stronger coverage. This is positive evidence of a mathematical gap, not a proof of historical uniqueness.
residual_risks: Unindexed papers, theses or alternative finite-state formulations may contain an equivalent face enumerator; keyword/semantic searches cannot establish unique historical priority.
Only accessible earlier records and published claims were compared; complete unindexed earlier history is not warranted.

value.rationale: The object is the natural edge-membership learning family for all perfect matchings of a connected planar ladder, where the scalar VC dimension and an online gap were already known. Complete face counts and individual-support membership are materially stronger, provide local matching/regular-language structure and demonstrate a nonpure support complex already on six columns. Every coefficient for all widths is resolved, not merely an arbitrary small numerical slice or routine dimension restatement.
